backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a radio streaming backend with track/playlist management, user profiles, background GIF settings, blob storage, and role-based access control (admin/DJ/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single feature (CreatePlaylistFromLibraryDialog media library refresh) with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend components including App, hooks, RadioPlayer, DJDashboard, MediaLibrary, upload dialogs, and playlist management interfaces with mobile responsiveness and AirPlay support.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, manifest link, favicon, and theme color configuration for Bonsai Radio.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, display mode, theme colors, and icon configuration for installability.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication state, automatic session restoration, smooth transitions between RadioPlayer and DJDashboard, and initialization of default background GIFs on first admin login.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistDia: Modal dialog for adding single or multiple tracks to one or more playlists with mode selection, checkboxes, batch operations, and success notifications.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayControl.t: Button component for triggering AirPlay device picker with visual feedback for connection state, availability detection, and tooltip for unsupported browsers.
frontend/src/components/AirPlayPlaybackA: Alert component displaying AirPlay connection issues with a retry button for manual recovery attempts.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundGifOve: Displays a random GIF overlay that changes when tracks change, with configurable transparency, fade duration, and animation intensity settings fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundVisual: Manages background GIF uploads, deletion, and settings (transparency, fade duration, animation intensity, randomization) with upload queue retry logic and preview functionality.
frontend/src/components/BatchEditTrackDi: Dialog component for batch editing metadata (title, artist, album, duration) across multiple selected tracks with selective field application.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFo: Form for creating playlists by uploading audio files with metadata extraction from Web Audio API, upload progress tracking, and error handling with retry queue.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistFr: Dialog for creating playlists from existing media library tracks with search/filter, multi-select, and select-all functionality.
frontend/src/components/CyberpunkBackgro: Canvas-based animated cyberpunk background with particles, flares, and light beams that react to audio data (volume, bass, mid, high frequencies) with parallax effects.
frontend/src/components/DJAuthModal.tsx: Modal dialog for DJ authentication using Internet Identity, with session checking, login flow management, and toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/components/DJDashboard.tsx: Main DJ dashboard component that verifies admin access, displays playlists and media library stats, and includes logout functionality with a cyberpunk-themed background.
Dialog component for editing track metadata (title, artist, album, duration) with form validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/EmbeddedMusicPla: Full-featured music player with playlist selection, audio playback controls, volume normalization, AirPlay support, buffer state management, and audio analysis integration.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Full-screen loading component with animated logo, pulsing dots, and cyberpunk-themed gradient background.
frontend/src/components/MediaLibrary.tsx: Media library management component with search, sorting, multi-select, batch operations, track editing/deletion, and playlist creation from selected tracks.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploadDialo: Dialog component for uploading audio files with metadata extraction, duration detection, progress tracking, and upload system readiness checks with automatic retry for queued uploads.
frontend/src/components/PlaylistList.tsx: Displays a list of playlists with their tracks, showing track metadata (title, artist, album), duration, and play count in a styled card layout.
Tabbed interface for managing playlists, media library, music player, and background visuals with persistent tab selection stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/RadioPlayer.tsx: Main radio player component with playlist selection, playback controls, volume normalization, AirPlay support, buffer state management, and listener session tracking with adaptive buffering for AirPlay.
frontend/src/components/StreamStabilityI: Visual indicator component displaying stream stability state (stable, buffering, error) with color-coded icons and labels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication and admin token initialization, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlay.ts: Hook for managing AirPlay functionality on Safari, detecting support, availability, connection state, and providing a method to show the AirPlay device picker.
frontend/src/hooks/useAirPlayPlaybackRec: Hook that automatically recovers audio playback when AirPlay connection state changes by reloading the source, restoring playback position, and resuming playback.
frontend/src/hooks/useAudioAnalyzer.ts: React hook that analyzes audio in real-time using Web Audio API, extracting frequency bands (bass, mid, high), volume, spectral centroid, and bass kick detection with adaptive throttling for mobile/desktop performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for interacting with the backend canister, including playlist management, listener sessions, play count tracking, background GIF uploads, and media library operations with authentication and error normalization.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadSystemReadin: React Query hook that checks upload system readiness by verifying user authentication, admin/DJ permissions, and blob storage availability with automatic polling during initialization.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH-based neon cyberpunk color system, glow utilities, and audio-reactive animations including pulse, ripple, and text glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/types/airplay.d.ts: TypeScript declarations for Safari's WebKit AirPlay APIs, extending HTMLMediaElement with AirPlay-specific methods and events.
frontend/src/utils/airplayBufferingStrat: Configuration and utility functions for managing audio buffering strategies with different thresholds and recovery attempts for AirPlay versus standard playback.
frontend/src/utils/audioFileUtils.ts: Provides audio file validation by checking MIME types and extensions, and extracts audio duration using Web Audio API with HTMLAudioElement fallback. Includes utilities for parsing and formatting duration strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL parameter extraction from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state across navigation. Includes functions to store, retrieve, and clear parameters from both URL and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended border radius variables, custom animations (accordion, pulse-glow, ripple-glow), and container settings. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking a fix request for playlist creation failing with 'track is not in the media library' error after successful upload. Contains one existing feature for refreshing media library queries and one pending fix request.
